text: ニャースとか　ペルシアンて　ちょー　かわいーよ！

structure.jp: ニャースとか　ペルシアンて
ちょー　かわいーよ！

patterns.name: 〜とか
patterns.explanation: とか after a thing gives it as one example, like 'things like'. ニャースとか = 'Meowth and the like'.

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: て here is a shortened って, a casual way to bring up what you are about to talk about, in place of は. ペルシアンて = 'Persian, well, they'.
